reasons.plausibility: Introducing a small amount of Nb in Ti–Ni high-entropy alloys for improved high-temperature strength is scientifically credible, with only minor uncertainties about potential phase stability and processing.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of mechanical properties and microstructure between Nb-doped and undoped samples under identical high-temperature conditions provides a clear and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis addresses a direct route to improving elevated-temperature mechanical performance in Ti–Ni-based HEAs and proposes a specific, tractable experimental plan to validate or refute it.
